title: #268 External appearances
prompt: One should never judge a person by external appearances. Do you agree or disagree? Support your ideas with details.

promptSegments.text: One should never judge a person by external appearances.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu rõ mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Bảo vệ quan điểm bằng 2 lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Sử dụng các dẫn chứng thực tế thuyết phục để củng cố luận điểm.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: A person's appearance is not an indicator of their true feelings, as demonstrated by examples of kind people who might be underestimated due to their simple looks.

angles.en: A person's actions are more revealing of their personality than their looks, as shown by the example of someone who smiles often and builds good relationships.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: A person's actions are more revealing of their personality than their looks, as shown by the example of someone who smiles often and builds good relationships.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: A person's look is not the only thing that matters, because qualities like kindness and actions are more important.
